candidate_tasks.title: Define L-length on an ordinary Ricci-flow domain
candidate_tasks.proposed_Lean_statement_or_precise_contr: No Lean name exists; do not invent one as if it were already declared. Contract: on a product spacetime domain for an ordinary (nonsurgery) family g : R -> RiemannianMetric with IsRicciFlowOn g J, and a base point (x,T) with T in J, define the backward-time L-energy of a piecewise-smooth path gamma with t(gamma(tau))=T-tau by integral_0^{bar tau} sqrt(tau) * (scalarCurvature(gamma(tau)) + |X|^2) d tau, with X the spatial velocity relative to the time vector. Then define L_x and l_x = L_x/(2 sqrt(bar tau)) as infima over such paths staying in a declared smooth open set. Restrict to ordinary flows; do not encode surgery charts, unscathed regions, or reduced-volume monotonicity in the definition. L-geodesics, L-exp, and reduced volume are later consumers, not part of this definition.
